nextCandidate.reason: First unrebuilt high-value finance intent selected after state recovery. Build must not start before PRE-BUILD audit.

globalDecisions: Do not mass-delete or noindex existing calculator portfolio solely because of AdSense rejection.
Do not use a fixed word-count target.
Do not mass-generate one universal V-next template.
Use current best recent pages as reference, not as a pattern to clone blindly.
After every 8–12 fully rebuilt calculators, run a site-level quality review before deciding on the next wave or AdSense re-review.

findings.templateRisk: LOW: no exact repeated content blocks across 3+ rebuilt pages; highest pairwise main-text token Jaccard ≈ 0.219.
findings.integration: PASS: all 10 pages present in registry, sitemap, catalog and relevant hub; each has contextual calculator links.
findings.brandTrust: PASS: all 10 use RV V3.2 brand assets and official FB/IG footer links.
findings.staticIntegrity: PASS: 0 duplicate IDs and 0 invalid JSON-LD in the 10-page sample.
findings.dataLayer: 36 datasets / 772 scenarios and observations after calculator #10.
followups: Dedicated OG/social image coverage is incomplete; most rebuilt pages still reuse generic OG assets.
Keep title/meta cleanup separate from HOLD pages unless there is a concrete SERP reason.
Do not judge Wave 1 from GSC yet: most Wave 1 MAJOR changes are 2026-08-17/18 and existing GSC evidence predates them.
Prefer a second production wave over an immediate broad re-edit of Wave 1.

findings.productClarity: PASS after #16 clarity rebuild; Primary Intent + Plain Language Gate is now mandatory.
findings.comparisonIntegrity: PASS after #19 correction; fixed examples and rate bands must not share one comparison scale.
findings.navigationAndAlignment: PASS after #18/#20 fixes; no competing top-level navigation and equal-card alignment must be visually locked.
findings.visualDistinctiveness: PASS: Wave 2 spans floor order desk, insulation blueprint, drywall material desk, masonry wall, plaster studio, house budget atlas, kitchen, bathroom, renovation X-ray and material measure board.
findings.releasePackaging: PASS: FULL RELEASE packaging became mandatory during the wave.
findings.nextWave: Shift to high-intent finance/business utilities with exact outputs and strong GSC opportunity; start with DPH.
